edges: The center of Hurricane Beatriz passed near La Fortuna, Mexico.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Tropical Depression Two-E developed into Tropical Storm Beatriz.
Hurricane Beatriz caused flooding in Acapulco.
Hurricane Beatriz caused evacuations in Acapulco.
Hurricane Beatriz brushed the western coast of Mexico.
The Government of Mexico issued warnings for Hurricane Beatriz.
Hurricane Beatriz produced heavy rain in Guerrero.
Hurricane Beatriz dissipated southwest of Cabo Corrientes.
